reply.message:
**I haven’t proposed or changed the layout yet**—you’re still seeing your original sofa and table positions. My last message offered three ways to make it cozier.

The rug-and-lamps option would visually tie the seating area together and add softer, more intimate lighting while retaining your sofa. Warmer wall colours would change the mood; rearranging would focus on grouping what you already own.

My recommendation is to start with **a rug and lamps around the existing sofa**, subject to checking fit and catalog prices.
